name: yf_mutual_fund_holders
description:
Largest mutual fund holders of one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance mutualfund_holders), usually the top 10.
Returns: {symbol, holders: [{Date Reported, Holder, pctHeld, Shares, Value, pctChange}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Institutions: yf_institutional_holders; ownership percentages: yf_major_holders.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
